metrics.numerator: started and every actual planned match (scheduledMatches preferred, legacy fallback disclosed) has a legal non-tied score and status is finished and rankings are present
metrics.timeWindow: createdAt cohort; completion week requires complete scoredAt coverage or an explicitly labeled legacy proxy

metrics.numerator: effective completions in trailing four Asia/Shanghai calendar weeks
metrics.timeWindow: Asia/Shanghai Monday-Sunday with explicit zero weeks; moving average requires four complete observed weeks
metrics.source: complete match.scoredAt coverage; legacy finishedAt/shareActivityUpdatedAt proxy is labeled separately

metrics.denominator: first-observed organizers with a complete 28-day observation window
metrics.numerator: denominator actors creating another tournament within 28 days
metrics.deduplication: creator actor in memory only; public output is aggregate
metrics.limitation: survivor-based and left-censored unless older history is supplied

metrics.denominator: first-observed non-guest participants with a complete 28-day observation window
metrics.numerator: denominator actors present in another tournament within 28 days
metrics.timeWindow: tournament createdAt proxy through day 28 inclusive
metrics.deduplication: exclude creator occurrence, duplicate roster item and imported guest
metrics.limitation: no joinedAt; createdAt is only a proxy

metrics.denominator: same eligible participant cohort as participant_28d_rejoin
metrics.timeWindow: tournament createdAt proxy through day 28 inclusive
metrics.deduplication: actor in memory only; imported guest excluded

metrics.numerator: count for identical mode x playersCount x courts x totalMatches x presetKey x templateKey x engine
metrics.deduplication: tournament _id; missing and unknown are explicit categories

metrics.denominator: successful dailyVisitTrend response day containing the expected metric row
metrics.numerator: platform field visit_uv for that natural day
metrics.timeWindow: Asia/Shanghai daily rows, deduplicated by ref_date
metrics.deduplication: type + ref_date; overlapping fetch batches must not be summed
metrics.limitation: window totals are daily UV person-days, not users deduplicated across days; successful responses without a row are excluded, not filled as zero

metrics.denominator: successful dailyVisitTrend response day containing the expected metric row
metrics.numerator: platform field visit_pv for that natural day
metrics.timeWindow: Asia/Shanghai daily rows, deduplicated by ref_date
metrics.limitation: successful responses without a row are excluded, not filled as zero

metrics.denominator: visit_uv on a day with a successful dailyVisitTrend response and visit_uv > 0
metrics.timeWindow: ratio of summed daily new-UV person-days to summed daily UV person-days; do not average missing days as zero
metrics.limitation: person-day ratio is not the share of users deduplicated across the window

metrics.denominator: successful dailyVisitTrend response day containing the expected metric row
metrics.numerator: session_cnt, stay_time_uv, stay_time_session and visit_depth as returned by the platform
metrics.timeWindow: daily and disclosed complete-day windows only
metrics.aggregation: stay_time_uv is weighted by daily visit_uv; stay_time_session and visit_depth are weighted by daily session_cnt; zero-weight and missing rows are excluded

metrics.denominator: successful visitPage response days containing page rows
metrics.numerator: page_visit_pv and page_visit_uv aggregated by normalized page route
metrics.timeWindow: daily rows within the disclosed coverage window
metrics.deduplication: type + ref_date + route; strip query and fragment before public aggregation
metrics.limitation: summed page UV is page-level UV person-days and can repeat across pages and days

metrics.denominator: sum of access_source_session_cnt values on successful visitDistribution days
metrics.numerator: session count for the same platform source key
metrics.limitation: platform source codes are retained as numeric keys because the fetched evidence does not contain a versioned label dictionary; source is not a single-tournament share conversion

metrics.denominator: platform-provided cohort denominator for the matching new/all-user retention series
metrics.numerator: platform-provided retained user value for the exact day/week/month offset
metrics.timeWindow: dailyRetain, weeklyRetain and monthlyRetain rows with their platform ref_date
metrics.deduplication: endpoint type + ref_date + cohort kind + offset key
metrics.limitation: only cohorts containing the exact requested offset are eligible; immature, missing or unsupported offsets remain unavailable and are never filled with zero; D1/W1/W4/M1 use different cohort grains

metrics.denominator: not applicable; platform dailySummary.visit_total is a cumulative endpoint value
metrics.numerator: first observed value, last observed value and their endpoint delta
metrics.timeWindow: first and last observed dailySummary rows within the disclosed window
metrics.limitation: endpoint delta is not a deduplicated count of users acquired within the inclusive window
